input.prompt: Use case: stylized game sprite. Paint OUR Daoist Child's front-facing walk as exactly three original drawings in a single horizontal transparent PNG strip of three equal square cells. Refs 4 and 5 set the handcrafted Chinese Daoist Q finish, warm softened contours, amber, ivory and jade. Fixed straight-on camera and eye line. Keep the large round head, soft smile, spiky dark-brown hair, gold headband with a knot and two ribbon tails on screen RIGHT, cream crossover shirt, teal embroidered robe, round belt medallion, pale puff trousers and teal-gold boots. Our child carries a gold double gourd with a taiji medallion and red tassel in the hand on screen RIGHT throughout, with the empty hand on screen LEFT. Keep the same head width, robe hem length, waist height, boot design and foot-floor level across all three. Boots point toward camera, no turns, no lunge and no side-facing pose. Follow the BOTTOM row of refs 2 and 3, read left to right, with modest changes increasing through the walk. f21: both feet side-by-side and flat at the same height, elbows neutral, both eyes closed in a quick blink. f22: open both eyes, keep the screen LEFT boot planted at the established baseline, move the screen RIGHT boot distinctly higher on the image by a small step, about one half of the boot's height. The raised right boot is foreshortened; show the shortened RIGHT leg beneath its right robe opening. Both feet stay in their own column. Both hands low. f23: the screen LEFT boot stays down, the RIGHT boot now sits even higher, visibly behind the planted shoe by close to one whole shoe height. Bring the screen RIGHT gourd and holding sleeve a little forward and up together. Empty hand remains screen LEFT. Distinct soles vertically staggered. Paint each of these three phases as an in-place front walk with the gourd consistent, like the native source viewed straight ahead.
